data.name: Khatija
data.gender_notes: Khatija is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khatija is an Arabic name that symbolizes purity and chastity. It is a popular name among Muslims, especially in South Asia. The name Khatija carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khatija usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Khatija is associated with purity of heart and soul.
data.etymology: Khatija belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khatija total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: خديجة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الخصوبة و الثراء المعنوي
in_arabic.long_meaning: خديجة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، و يعني الخصوبة و الثراء المعنوي، و هو مشتق من كلمة خَدَجَ التي تعني حمل الحامل مولودها قبل أوانه، و قد ورد ذكر اسم خديجة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الهمزة، و هي زوجة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم و أول من آمن برسالته

in_urdu.name: خدیجہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو خصوبت اور معنوی دولت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: خدیجہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے خصوبت اور معنوی دولت، یہ لفظ خَدَجَ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حمل کے وقت سے قبل مولود کو جنم دینا، اور قرآن کریم میں سورة الهمزة میں اس کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور یہ نام النبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زوجہ اور ان کی رسالت کے پہلے معتقد کی نام ہے

in_hindi.name: खदीजा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम आध्यात्मिक समृद्धि और उर्वरता की प्रतीक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: खदीजा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, और इसका अर्थ है आध्यात्मिक समृद्धि और उर्वरता, यह नाम خَدَجَ से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है समय से पहले बच्चे को जन्म देना, और यह नाम कुरआन में सूरतुल हम्ज़ा में उल्लिखित है, और यह नाम पैगंबर मुहम्मद की पत्नी और उनकी सबसे पहले अनुयायी का नाम था

in_pashto.name: خدیجہ
in_pashto.meaning: دغه نوم د بډايي او معنوي شتمنګۍ ښکارندوی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خدیجہ د ښځينو يو نوم دی، چي د عربي ژبې څخه يې اخستل سوي دی، او دغه نوم د بډايي او معنوي شتمنګۍ معنا لري، دا کلمه د خَدَجَ څخه اخستل سوي ده چي د حمل د وخت څخه د مخکي د ماشوم د زېږېدنو معنی ورکوي، او دغه نوم د قرآن کريم په سورت الهمزة کې يادونه شوی دی، او دغه نوم د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د مېرمنې او د ده د پېغام د لومړنيو منونکو يو نوم دی

in_english.name: Khatija
in_english.meaning: a name that signifies spiritual richness and fertility
in_english.long_meaning: Khatija is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning spiritual richness and fertility, derived from the Arabic root خَدَجَ, which means to give birth before the due date, mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Humazah, and historically significant as the name of the wife of Prophet Muhammad and the first person to believe in his message, symbolizing faith, piety, and strong spiritual connection

data.cultural_impact: Khatija is a name that holds a significant place in Islamic history. The name is believed to have been given to Prophet Muhammad's first wife, Khadija bint Khuwaylid. She was a successful businesswoman, widely respected and admired in her community, and it was her unwavering faith and support that convinced Prophet Muhammad of his prophethood. The name has been passed down through generations, and many Muslim families continue to name their daughters Khatija in honor of the prophet's beloved wife.
data.spiritual_significance: Khatija is a name that evokes purity, grace, and strength. In Islamic tradition, Khadija is considered a role model for Muslim women, embodying the ideals of modesty, intelligence, and devotion to God. The name is believed to bring blessings and protection to its bearer, reminding them of the virtues of faith, patience, and perseverance. Ultimately, the name Khatija is a reminder of the divine grace and guidance that God bestows upon His chosen servants, inspiring them to live their lives with dignity and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Khadija bint Khuwaylid was the first wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Khatija carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Khadija was a wealthy merchant and businesswoman in Mecca before she married Muhammad. She was also an early supporter of Islam and is considered one of the four 'Mothers of the Believers' in Islamic tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Khatija remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
